title: 第9章 盗墓小贼第10章 我不是蝼蚁
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
漆黑的夜空下，
美姑连绵不绝的大山，
传来一声声悠长的哀嚎，
神秘而又恐怖，
几条人影在黒暗中如履平地的穿梭，
黑夜中，
第一个黑影在山沟沟竹林后山停下，
竹林下的茅草土屋一片漆黑，
破败不堪，
竹林枯叶在茅草屋顶堆的越来越厚，
篱笆院子到处都是飘落的黄叶，
几株高大的芭蕉树的大叶片已经有枯叶，
结了一些黄色仔仔和一串串青芭蕉，
院子里杂草丛生，
在夜风中荒凉又萧瑟，
竹林后面有两座石坟，
石坟上黄白经幡在夜风中飘来荡去，
坟头已经有荒草，
小石头砸着的花花绿绿冥钱已经风吹雨淋褪色腐烂。
黑影如刀的粗眉又粗又长，

灰黑的粗眉延长到蓬乱的发中耳边，
此刻扭动了两下，
暗黄灰白的大板脸有些扭曲的笑了笑，
牛鼓眼中灰黑气朦朦胧胧，
露出灰黑尖牙。
挥着一寸多长的弯弯的灰指甲黝黑大手，开始刨坟。
‘砰砰砰’，
几十上百斤的坟头石块被扔到一旁撞的乒乓乱响，
石坟的黄土已经有些发黑，
诡异的黑影的黑脸挂着有些怪异的笑容，
因为石坟黑棺木已经露了出来，
应该是棺材中的尸体露出地面风化，尸体腐烂流出尸水，
飘出一股股腐蚀味道，
漆黑的夜空冷月月圆居然穿破的厚厚的乌云，
冷色月光披洒下来，
content_en:
Under the dark night sky,
The beautiful mountains are endless,
There was a long wailing sound,
Mysterious and terrifying,
Several figures shuttled in the darkness as if they were walking on the ground,
in the dark night,
The first black shadow stopped on the mountain behind the bamboo forest in the ravine.
The thatched mud house under the bamboo forest was completely dark.
dilapidated,
The dead leaves of the bamboo forest are piled thicker and thicker on the thatched roof,
The fenced yard is full of falling yellow leaves,
The large leaves of several tall banana trees already have dead leaves.
I got some yellow cubs and bunches of green plantains,
The yard is overgrown with weeds,
Desolate and desolate in the night wind,
There are two stone tombs behind the bamboo forest.
The yellow and white prayer flags on the stone tomb were fluttering in the night wind.
There are already weeds on the grave,
The colorful coins hit by small stones have faded and rotted due to wind and rain.
The black shadow is like a knife, and the thick eyebrows are thick and long,
Thick gray-black eyebrows extend to the ears in the unkempt hair,
Twisted twice at this moment,
The big dark yellow and gray face smiled in a twisted way,
Niugu's eyes are gray and black, hazy,
Revealing gray and black fangs.
Waving his big, dark hands with curved gray nails over an inch long, he began to dig into the grave.
‘Bang bang bang’,
Dozens or hundreds of kilograms of tomb stones were thrown aside, making a ping-pong sound.
The loess of the stone tomb has turned somewhat black.
The strange shadow has a weird smile on its dark face,
Because the black coffin of the stone tomb has been exposed,
It should be that the corpse in the coffin was exposed to the ground and weathered, and the corpse rotted and leaked corpse water.
A corrosive smell wafts out,
The cold, full moon in the dark night sky actually broke through the thick dark clouds,
The cold moonlight shines down,
